items.title: Woman charged with hate crimes in attack on two Jewish men in NYC
items.brief: A woman accused of assaulting two men in allegedly antisemitic attacks in New York City was charged with hate crimes connected to those incidents, according to police and court records.

items.title: Lula defeats Trump ally Bolsonaro, keeping Brazil left as Latin America shifts right
items.brief: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won reelection Sunday, defeating Senator Flávio Bolsonaro , an ally of US President Donald Trump, in a razor-thin race that capped a deeply polarized presidential race.

items.title: Ammonia threat contained at burning Oregon seafood plant, officials say
items.brief: The threat of an ammonia leak from a burning seafood plant in a coastal Oregon city has been contained after firefighters worked to control the blaze, local officials said Sunday afternoon.

items.title: 11-year-old, other minors among 11 shot near Florida A&M University stadium
items.brief: A shooting near the football stadium at Florida A&M University in Tallahassee left 11 people with gunshot wounds Saturday night, officials said.

items.title: Presidential race in Bulgaria heads to runoff due to record low turnout
items.brief: The presidential election in Bulgaria on Sunday ended inconclusively, with the next head of state to be picked in a runoff, according to election officials.
